We've proven the model. Now we're ready to go much bigger. Over the next few years, our ambition for Uganda is to dramatically scale transfer volume—reaching thousands more recipients—while building the efficiency to do it sustainably. This isn't incremental growth. It's a step-change in what's possible, and we're hiring the person who will lead it. This person will also lead a talented team deeply committed to the communities they work in and to helping more households move out of poverty. Be a thought partner: Provide analytical support to help the team clear execution bottlenecks. Build for scale: Design the operation needed for the next order of magnitude, not just the one that exists today.
